newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid lingering bearishness.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid lingering bearishness.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down as the bear trend continued for a second week, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 40.04 points or 2.71 percent at 1,434.20 on a turnover of 87.08 million taka. Of 114 traded issues 77 gained and 35 lost.

"Higher market liquidity and shortfall in funds due to investment in mostly rights shares have triggered selling," said one broker. Singer Bangladesh lost 1,055 taka to 9,591, Apex Foods shed 205 to 2,685 and Bata Shoe fell 11 to 169.
